name: Question 5
problem:
Which of the following matrices are transformed into the $3\times 3$ identity matrix after applying the row operations ${R}_{1}↔{R}_{2}\,$ and $\,{R}_{1}:={R}_{1}+5{R}_{2}?$

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}0 & -5 & 0 \\ -5 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}],\,B=[\begin{aligned}0 & 1 & 0 \\ 1 & -5 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}],\,C=[\begin{aligned}0 & 0 & 1 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \\ 1 & 0 & 5\end{aligned}]
$$
worked_solution:
Let's apply the operations to each of the matrices:

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =[\begin{aligned}0 & -5 & 0 \\ -5 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}] & {R}_{1} & ↔{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}-5 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & -5 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}] & {R}_{1} & :={R}_{1}+5{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}-5 & -25 & 0 \\ 0 & -5 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}] \\  & \ne I\,\times  \\ B & =[\begin{aligned}0 & 1 & 0 \\ 1 & -5 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}] & {R}_{1} & ↔{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -5 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}] & {R}_{1} & :={R}_{1}+5{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}] \\  & =I\,✓ \\ C & =[\begin{aligned}0 & 0 & 1 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \\ 1 & 0 & 5\end{aligned}] & {R}_{1} & ↔{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}0 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 \\ 1 & 0 & 5\end{aligned}] & {R}_{1} & :={R}_{1}+5{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}0 & 1 & 5 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 \\ 1 & 0 & 5\end{aligned}] \\  & \ne I\,\times \end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the correct answer is "$B$ only".

Question 5
?

Which of the following matrices are transformed into the 3×3 identity matrix after applying the row operations R1↔R2 and R1:=R1+5R2?

A=[0−50−500001],B=[0101−50001],C=[001010105]

a
A and C only
b
C only
c
B only
d
A and B only
e
A only
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

Let's apply the operations to each of the matrices:

A=[0−50−500001]R1↔R2∼[−5000−50001]R1:=R1+5R2∼[−5−2500−50001]≠I×B=[0101−50001]R1↔R2∼[1−50010001]R1:=R1+5R2∼[100010001]=I✓C=[001010105]R1↔R2∼[010001105]R1:=R1+5R2∼[015001105]≠I×

Therefore, the correct answer is "B only".
